purpose: Select exactly one finite offline Campaign103 mechanism after Campaign102 without reading a Campaign103 candidate value, paired-support result, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: A new static aggregator over the same current-session library would be a prohibited Campaign101 rescue or an unbounded post-result aggregator search.
Changing fitting target, lambda, coefficient bound, component subset, missing-score treatment, or weighting rule would be a prohibited Campaign102 model retry.

This asks a new temporal question: whether a stock improves relative to the cross-section across many independently frozen mechanisms between consecutive accepted sessions. It uses no return, fit, learned weight, selected subset, current-level order statistic, or Candidate49 state.

selected_candidate.name: full_numeric_library_directional_rank_improvement_breadth_130f
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: Broad one-session improvement in a stock's relative standing across heterogeneous close-known mechanisms may identify coordinated information assimilation rather than a high static level in only a few factors, and may persist from the next open through the third close.
selected_candidate.source: The immutable Campaign102 130-column directional-rank design snapshot only.
selected_candidate.prior_session: the immediately preceding accepted local session t-1 from the snapshot's complete 1,632-session calendar; never the previous observed stock row
selected_candidate.formula: Require the current and exact-prior stock-day rows both to have model_support_eligible=true. For each of the exact 130 ordered components, retain the pair only when both directional ranks are finite. Give vote 1 when current>prior, 0.5 on exact float32 equality, and 0 when current<prior. Return the arithmetic mean of all retained votes.
selected_candidate.paired_component_floor_derivation: Each eligible row has at least 98 finite components. For two subsets of a 130-component library, inclusion-exclusion gives an intersection of at least 98+98-130=66. The floor adds no candidate-specific support restriction beyond requiring both frozen support flags.
selected_candidate.missing_rule: Missing when there is no exact-prior accepted session, no matching instrument row on that session, either row fails the frozen Campaign102 98-of-130 support, fewer than 66 finite pairs are observed, or the result is not finite in [0,1]. Never bridge a suspension or absent row, fill a component, carry a rank, or replace a missing pair with a vote.

decision: Proceed only after a complete semantic/support overlap audit and a fingerprint-bound no-return preregistration are frozen.
